Chapter 10: Living with Purpose and Moving Forward
You know, the word purpose gets thrown around a lot. But when you really think about it, what does it mean to you? For some people, purpose is all about career or achieving big goals. For others, it’s woven into relationships, creativity, or the simple act of helping someone else.
Let me share a story. Imagine someone who’s spent years chasing awards and recognition—always striving for that next big achievement. At first, every win feels amazing. But over time, those trophies and compliments start to lose their shine. One day, in the quiet after all the noise fades, they realize something’s missing.
It’s in those quiet moments that new questions begin to surface. What really matters? What actually brings meaning? These answers don’t show up out of nowhere. Instead, they reveal themselves slowly—in the tiny choices we make every day. Maybe it’s lending a hand to a neighbor. Or finally picking up a hobby you’ve always wanted to try. Or just spending real, quality time with the people you love.
Turns out, purpose isn’t about making grand, sweeping gestures. It’s about living in a way that lines up with your values—day in and day out.
Now, think about a recent graduate. They’re staring at the future, feeling totally overwhelmed by the idea that they have to “make something” of their life. The pressure is real, and the fear of making the wrong move can be paralyzing. But through a mix of trial and error—and some good advice from mentors—a path slowly starts to appear. It’s never a perfect straight line. Sometimes you move forward, sometimes you slip back. But with each step, something amazing happens: you start to feel a bit more confident, not because you have all the answers, but because you know you can keep going.
What all these stories have in common is intention. Most of us wait for purpose to just show up, but the truth is, it’s something we build ourselves. Meaning is something we create, piece by piece, in the way we show up and the decisions we make.
So, here’s the key takeaway. Purpose isn’t a place you arrive—it’s a way of living. It’s about being present, making a difference—no matter how small—and trusting that every little step really does count. At the end of the day, it’s the journey, not the finish line, that fills our lives with richness.
